name: Gastonia Components and Logistics - Gastonia NC
type: Component / parts subassembly and logistics plant

fieldNotes.location: Geocoded point (GEOMETRIC_CENTER, moved only 44m) landed accurately on the campus. Confirmed: a large white-roofed components/logistics plant plus a separate gray-roofed building to the east, on a wooded campus off Tulip Drive south of I-85. DTNA / Waze listings confirm 'Daimler Truck North America Components & Logistics, 1400 Tulip Dr.'
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled vehicle entrance on the SE: Street View (captured 2026-02) shows a checkpoint canopy/gatehouse with orange bollards lining the lane and chain-link fencing; satellite shows a small white-canopy structure spanning the entry drive with a trailer passing through.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small canopied gatehouse structure sits over the SE entry lane. Functions as the staffed check-in point. Discrete booth form not perfectly resolvable; a 24/7 logistics plant of this scale runs manned security -> guardShack=true, remoteGs=false. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved aprons and the north drop yard provide internal holding before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal drives from the SE gate run a long way around the plant to the north drop yard and docks; easily 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated 25-50: dock doors with trailers backed in along the north face, plus banks on the west and SW faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 25-50 trailers parked in angled stalls in the dedicated north drop yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity on multiple distinct building faces (north, west, SW) consistent with separate shipping/receiving clusters; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has two distinct large buildings -- the main white components plant and a separate gray-roofed building to the east -- linked by an internal road.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot on the north side, full of parked trailers in marked angled stalls, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur observed entering the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site heavily ringed by woods, fronting I-85 on the south edge of Gastonia (a small city in the Charlotte metro). Per rubric tie-breaker -> Rural.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in the entry path.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single entry lane through the SE gate canopy as best resolved; flagged uncertain.
